decisions.topic: Degenerate Type 1 pattern BBox is treated as no clip
decisions.source_check: Physical p. 236 Table 74 says the BBox boundaries shall clip the cell and NOTE 1 says zero height/width still paints one pixel. Physical p. 399 §10.7.4 defines a scan-converted filled shape by crossed pixel squares, explicitly says a zero-width/height rectangle paints a one-pixel line, and says a clipping region consists of the pixels a fill would include. No EC3 Table 74 change was found.
decisions.code_check: content/pattern/tiling.rs discards BBox if either extent is zero; content/pattern/cell.rs then gives the cell only its outer clip. The in-code reading and ADR 0056 section 'Two edges are decided' interpret the note as leaving the whole cell unclipped.
decisions.test_check: The existing `a_cell_is_clipped_to_its_bounding_box` test is discriminating for positive extents but no degenerate-box paint test was found. Draft `drafts/degenerate_tiling_bbox_clip.rs` leaves the degenerate line's exact pixel ownership open, asserts a pixel near the line, and asserts distant cell ink is clipped, with the same cell under an ordinary BBox as a positive control.
decisions.status: Reconsider; likely source/code mismatch, draft unexecuted.
decisions.limit: This concerns degenerate BBox only. It does not decide empty intersection of a valid BBox with a separate clipping region. The source's scan-conversion rule is device-dependent at exact boundaries, so the draft avoids claiming the precise boundary row.

decisions.topic: Pattern inside Form maps to the Form's default space
decisions.source_check: Physical p. 235 §8.7.2 explicitly maps a pattern in a form to form default user space at Do. Physical p. 286 §8.10.1 says concatenate the form Matrix before painting. EC3 text retains this rule.
decisions.code_check: Pattern Matrix is composed with Interpreter.base, and form entry changes base to its mapped coordinate space during the form run.
decisions.test_check: `tiling.rs::a_pattern_inside_a_form_is_anchored_to_the_forms_space` uses a 10-unit form shift and samples points where page-space anchoring would disagree; the page-CTM independence test is also pixel-differential.
decisions.limit: Does not certify other aspects of form dictionaries or the unsupported PostScript cross-context case.

decisions.topic: Cell begins from its parent stream's initial graphics state
decisions.source_check: Physical pp. 236-237 §8.7.3.1 step b installs the graphics state from the beginning of the pattern's parent stream; Table 74's PaintType 1 entry separately specifies initial colors from the parent. §11.6.7 resets blend, soft mask and alpha constants for pattern definitions.
decisions.code_check: PatternInitial snapshots stream-start graphics state; cell_state installs it and applies the named §11.6.7 resets. Pattern parent-space base is also scoped while a cell is interpreted.
decisions.test_check: `tiling.rs::a_coloured_cell_starts_from_the_streams_initial_colours_rather_than_the_fills` distinguishes initial black from fill-time red, and `transparency.rs::a_pattern_in_a_form_starts_from_the_forms_state_at_its_do` covers a Form parent.
decisions.limit: The broad ADR includes transparency behavior excluded here and is not certified wholesale; no Type 1-in-Type 1 nested tiling assertion was found.

decisions.topic: TilingType 1/3 snap a lattice where device scale is stated
decisions.source_check: Physical p. 236 Table 74 permits cell, X/Y step and matrix adjustment for types 1/3 with its type-1 one-device-pixel bound; type 2 forbids cell distortion and allows spacing variation.
decisions.code_check: snap_lattice rounds step vectors and measures the transformed BBox corner displacement before accepting the transform; otherwise it preserves the file matrix. Type 2 uses exact stated spacing.
decisions.test_check: The tiling tests assert grid-aligned type-1 offsets, exact type-2 offsets, device-space bounds over a magnification sweep, and pixel-period distinction with type 2 as a negative control.
decisions.status: Retain for reviewed basic lattice behavior.
decisions.limit: The source says `may` adjust; this review does not require a processor to snap each file or certify all transforms, dimensions, and scale edge cases.

decisions.topic: A missing pattern Resources entry is read against an empty dictionary
decisions.source_check: No change to the resource-resolution conclusion in this pass. Table 74 requires Resources; §7.8.3/Errata and ADR 1059 own the reader policy reviewed elsewhere.
decisions.code_check: Current tiling interpreter reads the pattern's own resources dictionary and does not repeat the invoker lookup here.
decisions.test_check: Existing missing_resources and archive-specific pattern resource tests are outside this bounded behavior re-audit.
decisions.status: No reconsideration; prior artifact/policy relied upon but not revalidated in this shard.
decisions.limit: This is explicitly not a new certification of pattern resource resolution.
